main_measure.name: forecast-weighted mean 10-bar forward return minus holding

statistic.name: t of the forecast-weighted mean excess

main_measure.threshold: excess > 0 with t >= 2 to confirm; excess < 0 with t <= -2 to reject

supporting_check.name: hit rate of positive-forecast blocks minus hit rate of all blocks

decided_by: The excess is negative with t <= -2: reject.
reading: Blocks are bars at positions 0,10,20,... of each window for both groups, the holding mean and the all-bar hit rate use that same grid per coin and window, and the t is the forecast-weighted mean of per-block excesses over its weighted (sandwich) standard error across the pooled positive-forecast blocks.
